title: Post-3.1.1 Validation Remediation and Development Identity Reconciliation

preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: Local checkout and development environment are reconciled with current origin/main (fast-forwarded, stale .venv rebuilt with correct 3.1.1 identity).
The stale foreign editable RepoPact PATH installation (C:\Projects\repopact-wi050-windows-proof) is removed from the global Python 3.12 environment and replaced with stable PyPI repopact==3.1.1.

Package/runtime development identity complies with Decision 0032 (VERSION-pinned RELEASE_LABEL) before and during runtime-affecting source changes, then is promoted to a clean stable 3.1.2 identity for release.
Top-level `repopact --version` exists, exits 0 without requiring a subcommand, uses the governed package-version helper (no duplicated version constant), and is covered by tests.

rust/apps/repopact-desktop/scripts/generate-types.mjs no longer defaults CARGO_TARGET_DIR to the shared %TEMP%\repopact-rust-target; it inherits the caller's environment, uses the normal ignored rust/target workspace directory, and an explicit override still passes through. Covered by a regression test.

Full Python test suite (python -m unittest discover -s tests) passes with zero failures and zero errors attributable to code or test defects; only intentional skips and the operator-accepted C:\ProgramData\RepoPact\Guard host-state boundary (pre-existing WI050 native evidence on this machine, left untouched by operator instruction) may remain.
Full Rust workspace test suite (cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace) passes with zero failed tests.
Workbench types:check, typecheck, Vitest, and Vite build all pass, and the Tauri desktop Rust application compiles cleanly.

repopact validate, repopact dashboard, repopact spec, repopact verify quick, and the conformance suite all pass on the reconciled tree; repopact verify ci/release's own sub-checks (conformance, rust-workspace, cargo-metadata, spec-freshness) pass independently, with their overall result gated only by the same accepted AC-6 host-state boundary in the Python suite sub-check.

Public PyPI repopact==3.1.1 remains independently clean-installable in a fresh environment outside the checkout, and its bundled native engine handshake remains correct with no silent Python semantic fallback.

Current-state release/governance records (WI021 AC-3, WI066) accurately reflect the real published state (3.1.1, and 3.1.2 once published) without rewriting dated historical evidence describing the 3.1.0 milestone or the 3.1.1 corrective.

RepoPact 3.1.2 corrective patch release: exact proven tree promoted to stable VERSION=3.1.2 (RELEASE_LABEL removed), built, inspected, tagged v3.1.2, and published to PyPI; post-publication clean install confirms `repopact --version` reports 3.1.2 and the bundled native engine independently reports 3.1.2.
Final worktree is clean and all remediation/release commits are pushed to origin/main.
